verdict.rationale: New Relic AI lets users ask questions, troubleshoot issues and explore telemetry in plain language, and the official MCP server turns plain-English questions into NRQL. That establishes first-party natural-language interaction for querying and troubleshooting. The evidence does not show natural-language commands that operate or configure the product (creating alerts, dashboards or SLOs, or taking actions), and all support is vendor docs. Missing for 10: natural-language control of configuration and actions beyond querying, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: It allows you to ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and explore telemetry data using plain language.
Ask questions in plain English, and the MCP server converts them to NRQL to get results—even if you're not a NRQL expert.
If you're struggling to get a query to work, ask our AI assistant to help you.
